description: Copy a test under a new title: the test's info is copied over (start address, requirement, plan, options and files). Its run history and schedules stay with the original. The copy counts toward the plan's test limit. Without `title` it is named "<original title> (copy)". Pass `projectId` to put the copy in another project of the workspace.

projectId.description: Project for the copy (p_…); default: the original's project

title.description: Title of the copy (up to 200 characters); default: the original title with " (copy)"

name: duplicate_test
title: Duplicate a test
